name: UEVR
summary: Universal Unreal Engine VR injector. Hooks into UE4 and UE5 games to inject Dual-View Rendering, 6DOF headtracking, and motion controller support without game-specific code changes.
compatibility_notes: Unreal Engine 4 and 5 only. DX11 and DX12. Some games with anti-cheat are incompatible.
